title: Romans say Phoenicians sacrificed children to Molech

tellings.quote: their rights, including according to the Romans, they sacrificed their children to Molech.

plain: According to the Romans, the Phoenicians, the seafaring traders of the ancient Mediterranean, sacrificed their children to Molech, a god named in the Bible. The researcher Tim Alberino raises this with Michels while discussing Phoenician rites, in the context of Sardinia and Phoenicia, citing the Romans in general rather than any named text. He offers it as part of a darker picture of who the Phoenicians were.
